heading: INT. ICE RINK ZAMBONI GARAGE - EARLY MORNING

units.text: INT. ICE RINK ZAMBONI GARAGE - EARLY MORNING
A cinderblock garage that smells of diesel and frozen rubber.
A Zamboni, huge and patient, sits in the center like a sleeping bull.
Hockey sticks hang on pegs along the wall, taped blades pointing at the floor.
RUTHERFORD "RUDY" OYELARAN-STACK (60s) sits on an upturned bucket by the machine, a thermos between his knees.
He is a big man gone soft, with a face like weathered oak and eyes that have watched ten thousand early mornings.
He pours coffee into the thermos lid and offers it to no one in particular.
The side door opens.
MARISOL ECHEVERRIA-TANAKA (17) comes in carrying a hockey bag nearly as big as she is.
She wears a faded junior-league jersey and holds her skates by the laces.
She sets down the bag.
He nods.
She nods back.
Neither says anything.
It is a ritual.
Ice is good today.
units.name: RUDY

units.text: Good how?
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Hard. Fast. Clean.
units.name: RUDY

units.text: She laces her skates, standing one foot on the Zamboni's bumper.
He sips the coffee and lets her work.
A third figure leans in the doorway: COACH DAHLIA FENWICK-ABARA (40s, quilted parka, a clipboard held like a hymnal).
She watches Marisol lace for a moment, then glances at Rudy, who shrugs.
You're early.
units.name: COACH

units.text: So are you.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: I'm always early.
units.name: COACH

units.text: So am I.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: The Coach smiles, almost.
She sets the clipboard on the hood of the Zamboni.
At the far end of the garage, a second girl is already sitting on the bench, tying her own skates in silence: PHOEBE NAKAMURA-DELACROIX (16).
She does not look up.
Marisol sees her, and her shoulders tighten, then ease.
Hey, Phoebe.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Hey.
units.name: PHOEBE

units.text: That's all.
Rudy puts the lid back on the thermos.
He climbs onto the Zamboni and the engine coughs awake, roaring in the low room.
The big door rolls up, and a gray light pours across the ice.
Marisol steps out onto the surface first.
Phoebe follows.
Nobody speaks.
The blades cut their lines in the fresh ice.
